question: The 'SAKSHAM' campaign launched by the Government of India in January 2021 aims to spread awareness about ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**adoption of cleaner fuels.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• SAKSHAM__ is the name of the campaign launched by the Petroleum Conservation Research Association to spread awareness about ‘Green and Clean Energy'.
 
• The month-long campaign highlights the adverse health and environmental impacts of increasing carbon footprints.
 
• The idea of the SAKSHAM is to convince consumers to switch to cleaner fuels and bring in behavioural change to use fossil fuel intelligently.
 
• The campaign activities include cyclotron, farmer workshops, seminars, painting competitions, CNG vehicle driving contests, etc.
 
• The campaign will spread awareness about seven key drivers-
 __
 
• moving towards a gas-based economy
 
• **cleaner use of fossil fuels**
 
• greater reliance on domestic sources to drive bio-fuels
 
• achieving renewable targets with the set deadlines
 
• increased use of electric vehicles to decarbonize mobility
 
• increased use of cleaner fuels like Hydrogen
 
• digital innovation across all energy systems
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• A total of 152 Centre for Financial Literacy and Service Delivery** (SAKSHAM Centres)** across 77 districts of 13 states were launched under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) in October 2021.
